text:
ashley_support: Heads-up — acct acme-uk (acct_id: acct_6821) signed up ~11:02 GMT, email verified and added Apple Pay, but no free-trial credits appeared in console. Customer sees $0 credits. Ticket SUP-14231. Can billing confirm gating reason?
signup-bot: event: signup.created acct=acct_6821 region=GB email_verified=true payment_method=apple_pay bin_country=US ip_country=GB
mike_billing: Checking logs now. Our grant pipeline flags when payment BIN country != account region. I see bin_country=US vs acct region=GB -> flagged for manual review. 3DS state for ApplePay is empty/unknown. Quick query: `SELECT * FROM trial_grants WHERE acct_id='acct_6821';` -> no rows.
sophie_support: Customer insists card is UK-issued. Could be a virtual card routing through a US BIN. They need quick access to test the API. Any temporary manual grant we can do?
mike_billing: We can manual grant. Need ops approval and a short audit note. ops_ryan? Recommend reason: false-positive bin-country mismatch (ApplePay/virtual BIN).
ops_ryan: OK from ops for a one-off manual grant. Please add tag `manual_grant:bin-mismatch` and set status `investigating` in the audit trail. Also file a follow-up to product to revisit rule for Apple Pay flows. ✅
mike_billing: Applied manual grant. Command used: `UPDATE trial_grants SET amount=50, granted_by='mike_billing', reason='manual:bin-mismatch', note='SUP-14231' WHERE acct_id='acct_6821';` Notified customer and updated ticket SUP-14231 with logs.
ashley_support: On a quick call with the customer — credits are now visible in their console and they can call the API. Customer confirmed the balance. :tada:
mike_billing: I'll add a backlog item (BLG-210) to create an alert for spikes in ApplePay bin-country mismatches and add a unit test to the grant pipeline. Also will reconcile manual grants to metrics.
sophie_support: Thanks everyone. Marking the thread resolved from support side; leaving BLG-210 open for billing/product follow-up.
